name: Warrior
notes: Shared 1st class: §2.1 (Duelist path, sword) and §3.1 (Warlord path, polearm from 20). Rows of both tables are merged per skill; the weapon check (R1) picks the path.
§3.1 "Toggles / self-buffs: Vicious Stance, Accuracy, War Cry, Battle Roar, Lionheart, Detect Insect Weakness: same triggers as the Warrior in §2.1" = the same rows below.
Never auto: none in this band.
Party role (Duelist path): melee DD, assist the leader's target.
Party role (Warlord path): melee DD with splash. Only swing at monsters the tank holds (the fan pulls monsters that are not pulled yet).

rows.trig: Spam (3 s, 30 MP). It's a blow (blowChance 20): it lands more often from the side or behind.
Opener from range, then on cooldown (6 s, 67 MP: heavy MP for level 5-19, keep it as the opener only).
rows.why: Guide aspect: single target; its rule makes it the opener only (MP cost).

rows.trig: Duelist path: main skill, spam (3 s, 34 MP). Warlord path: needs sword/blunt → not with a polearm.
Only with a blunt. A Duelist-to-be uses a sword → skip. Warlord path: needs a blunt → not with a polearm.
Warlord path: single target = auto-attack + Wild Sweep.

Duelist path: fan attack, polearm only; not for the Gladiator path (sword). Warlord path (main AoE): fan attack (4 s, 34 MP), spam whenever 2+ monsters are in front; also fine on a single target. Only on monsters the tank holds.
From 24, fight only, when misses are visible (cheap).
rows.why: Hive has no miss check; switch on by hand when misses show.

rows.trig: P.Atk +, 60 s, reuse 45 s → cast at fight start and whenever it has dropped.
Max HP + heals the added HP (10 min, reuse 150 s). 🎯 HP < 50 % in a fight.
Stun/sleep/hold/paralyze resist 60 s (reuse 150 s). 🎯 After being stunned/slept, or vs bosses that stun.
rows.why: "after being stunned/slept" has no when key: only the boss part is machine-checked.

rows.trig: 🎯 Only when the hunting ground's monsters are insects (R8 slot).
Replaced by Power Smash at 20 (Duelist path). Warlord path: no polearm skill.
